name: Cannabis
overview: Scripture reveals that God created the earth to produce herbs and plants, including those bearing seed, which He declared good and provided for human use and sustenance (Genesis 1:12, 1:29; 9:3). The natural provision of herbs serves both practical and purposeful roles, such as food and service to mankind (Psalms 104:14). While specific plants like sweet calamus are mentioned in sacred contexts (Exodus 30:23), the overarching biblical narrative emphasizes God's sovereign design in providing herbs for the benefit and care of His creation.
